editorialMethod: Revised interpretive feature grounded in supplied exhibition photographs, organizer material, museum history and a dated artist interview about earlier work. Thesis: whether welcome depends on making the unwanted aesthetically desirable. Develops gold/material versus monument prestige, site versus visibility/privacy, and jaws versus spectator control. Counterreading: spectacle may turn exclusion into harmless decorative content. Explicitly distinguishes artist statements from Liv's reading. No rating, invented visit, fabricated interview, audience reaction or claimed independent history of pruning.
